description.zh: 内网访问应用地址。长度为1~128个字符，支持IPv4地址、CIDR、域名、泛域名、支持模糊查询。
description.en: The address of the private access application. The address must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It supports IPv4 addresses, CIDR blocks, domain names, and wildcard domain names. Fuzzy search is supported.

description.zh: 内网访问应用名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the private access application. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~100。
description.en: The number of entries per page for pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas list-user-applications --sase-user-id su_e8f218fb171edd167c2ad917d21f53148bdefc510ca1f3c3cc0249d3643d0000 --name private_access_application_name --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --address sase.alibaba.com --region cn-hangzhou
